extDescription.message: Sort GitHub repositories by recent activity, including creation, forks, and pushes, directly in GitHub.

sortActivityHint.message: Uses the newer of the creation and last push dates

sortCreatedHint.message: Sorts by the repository creation date

sortForkedHint.message: Sorts by the fork date; repositories that are not forks go last

sortPushedHint.message: Sorts by the last push date

sortUpdatedHint.message: Sorts by the metadata update date, including description edits

statusLoading.message: Loading repositories… $1 Showing GitHub's standard list.

statusLoadingIdle.message: Loading repositories… Showing GitHub's standard list.

statusLoadFailed.message: Could not load repositories: $1 Showing GitHub's standard list.

emptyFiltered.message: No repositories match the current filters.

ariaRepoList.message: Repository list sorted by Repo Sorter

standardHint.message: Star buttons, fork parents and contribution graphs are only available in GitHub's standard view.

errUnsupportedType.message: This Type is not available with Repo Sorter. Switch to All first.

errNoResponse.message: The extension did not respond. Reload the extension and try again.

errUnexpectedResponse.message: Received an unexpected response from the extension.

apiAuthFailed.message: GitHub authentication failed. Check your access token.

apiNotFound.message: Could not load the repository list (wrong owner name or no access).

apiRateLimited.message: The GitHub API rate limit was reached. Try again later.

apiRateLimitedAt.message: The GitHub API rate limit was reached. Try again after $1.

apiForbidden.message: The GitHub API denied the request. The token may lack permission.

apiServerError.message: The GitHub API returned a temporary error ($1).

apiNetworkError.message: Could not reach the GitHub API. Check your network connection.

apiMaxPages.message: Reached the page limit ($1 pages). Showing partial results.

apiInvalidResponse.message: Could not read the GitHub API response.

apiUnexpectedShape.message: The GitHub API returned an unexpected format.

apiLinkRepeat.message: The GitHub API kept returning the same page URL, so loading stopped.

apiLinkHost.message: The GitHub API returned a page URL on another host, so loading stopped.

apiViewerRead.message: Could not read the authenticated user information.

apiViewerMissing.message: Could not load the authenticated user information.

forbiddenSender.message: Could not verify the page that sent the request.

forbiddenOwner.message: The request owner does not match the page.

authTokenMissing.message: No access token is configured. Add one in the extension options.

ownerMismatch.message: The signed-in account ($1) does not match this page's owner ($2). Load the public list or remove the token.

forbiddenSettingsRead.message: Could not verify where the settings request came from.

forbiddenSettingsWrite.message: Could not verify where the settings update came from.

forbiddenAuthStatus.message: Not allowed to read the authentication status.

forbiddenAuthSet.message: Not allowed to set the token.

forbiddenAuthClear.message: Not allowed to remove the token.

forbiddenCacheClear.message: Not allowed to clear the cache.

optionsLead.message: Sort the repository list on a GitHub profile page by recent activity, treating creation, forks, and pushes as the same kind of activity.

tokenHint.message: Add a token to include your private repositories. Without one, only public repositories are loaded.

statusBackgroundUnavailable.message: Could not reach the background worker. Reload the extension.

statusUnavailable.message: Could not read the authentication status: $1

statusConfiguredNoUser.message: A token is configured, but the user information could not be loaded.

statusNotConfigured.message: Not configured: only public repositories are loaded.

persistLabel.message: Keep the token after a browser restart (stored as plain text in chrome.storage.local)

persistWarning.message: The token will be left on this device's disk in plain text. Leave this off on a shared computer or if device theft or malware is a concern. With it off, the token disappears when the browser closes.

tokenSectionNote1.message: A fine-grained token with only Metadata: Read on the target repositories is recommended. A classic token's repo scope is not read-only: it also grants write access.

tokenSectionNote2.message: The token is never handed to content scripts. By default it is stored in chrome.storage.session, which is cleared when the browser closes.

tokenSectionNote3.message: Nothing is sent to third-party servers. The only network destination is api.github.com.

tokenSectionNote4.message: If authentication fails, or another account is signed in, the extension does not silently switch to the public list. It shows an error instead.

usageStep1.message: Open the Repositories tab on a GitHub profile (https://github.com/<owner>?tab=repositories).

usageStep2.message: Pick an entry under "Repo Sorter" in GitHub's Sort menu. Choosing a standard entry returns to GitHub's own list.

usageStep3.message: Use GitHub's own search box and Type, Language and Visibility menus; they filter the whole fetched set.

usageStep4.message: Sort order and filters are saved per owner and restored on your next visit.

saveFailedBackground.message: Could not save. Reload the extension.

cleared.message: Removed the token and its saved copy. Only public repositories will be loaded.
